lines.text: ……有三个词在我脑中无尽回响，像坏掉的唱片一样重复着：你真酷，你真酷，你真酷。
lines.en: ...three words went through my mind endlessly, repeating themselves like a broken record: you're so cool, you're so cool, you're so cool.
lines.note: （核证证据：IMDb 角色台词页（Patricia Arquette as Alabama Whitman）https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0108399/characters/nm0000099/ 逐字收录；25YearsLater 回顾文 https://25yearslatersite.com/film/features/youre-so-cool-true-romance-will-always-burn-brightly/ 及 Vice https://www.vice.com/en/article/youre-so-cool-an-artists-homage-to-the-90s-cult-classic-true-romance/ 引全句）

lines.text: 既然是这样，那你告诉我，我是在撒谎吗？因为你，你有一半是茄子。
lines.en: Now, if that's a fact, tell me, am I lying? 'Cause you, you're part eggplant.
lines.note: （核证证据：IMDb 角色台词页（Dennis Hopper as Clifford Worley）https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0108399/characters/nm0000454/ 逐字："...now, if that's a fact, tell me, am I lying? 'Cause you, you're part eggplant."；IMDb Quotes https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0108399/quotes/ 同段独白。note：此为西西里独白收尾句；独白前文含原始种族俚语，为合规仅摘收尾逐字句）
